Professional Services Agreement (PSA) STATEMENT OF WORK

This Statement of Work (“SOW”) is for the purchase and provision of Services and Deliverables under the Professional Services Agreement referenced below. Capitalized terms not defined in this SOW have the meanings given in the Professional Services Agreement.

Professional Services Agreement Professional Services Agreement between [Customer] and [Provider] dated as of XXX

SOW #:

SOW Effective Date:

SOW Term: __ days from the SOW Effective Date

SPECIFICATIONS

Description of Services [Describe or attach or link to reference document]

Description of Deliverables [Describe or attach or link to reference document]

CUSTOMER DEPENDENCIES (See Section 3.2 of Professional Services Agreement)

Customer Dependency: Description: Due Date: (if any) Notes:

ACCEPTANCE (See Section 3.4 of Professional Services Agreement)

Deliverable: Due Date: Subject to Acceptance: (Y/N) Notes:

THIRD-PARTY MATERIALS (See Section 5.2 of Professional Services Agreement)

Third-Party Materials (List any Third-Party Materials to be included in Deliverables)

Open Source: (List and include complete license and copyright attribution information for any Open Source to be included in Deliverables)

Open Source under a Copyleft License: (Specify if Open Source provided under a Copyleft License is permitted by Customer and, if so, list)(See Section 5.3(c) of Professional Services Agreement)

RIGHTS IN DELIVERABLES (See Section 6 of Professional Services Agreement)

All Deliverables are [Licensed Deliverables][Assigned Deliverables] in accordance with the selection made by the parties under Rights in Deliverables on the Cover Page to the Professional Services Agreement, except for any exceptions specified below.

Exceptions: The following Deliverables will be treated as specified below:
